_comment: Retrieval-quality baselines for the 10-query SMOKE subset (scripts/run-eval-smoke.sh). Shrink-only for quality metrics (actual >= value - tolerance); raise-only for latency (actual <= value * (1 + tolerance)). A metric absent here is not gated. Raising a baseline is an explicit PR edit; lowering one requires justification in the PR body. See docs/EVALS.md.
_source: Direct-Qdrant offline retriever (no rerank/hybrid), 10-query smoke subset (first 10 golden rows), measured live 2026-09-19 against Qdrant http://127.0.0.1:6334. Measured: recall@5=0.1000 recall@10=0.2000 ndcg@5=0.0631 ndcg@10=0.0946 mrr=0.0625 p50=12409.2ms p95=14214.4ms. Values below are the measured numbers rounded down to a 0.01 grid (quality) / up (latency) so the gate is not flaky on re-runs.
